cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Command words tell you exactly what the examiner expects: 'describe' means give an account, 'explain' means give reasons, 'analyse' means break down and examine, 'evaluate' means make a judgement.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Describe questions require you to identify and outline film language features or production contexts without needing to explain their effect.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Explain questions require you to give reasons why something produces a particular effect or meaning, connecting technique to impact.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Analyse questions require you to break down a sequence or concept into its component parts and examine how they work together to create meaning.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Evaluate questions require you to make a judgement about effectiveness, supported by evidence, weighing strengths against weaknesses or comparing different interpretations.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: The Eduqas C680QS exam uses a range of question types from short one-mark identification questions to extended 15-mark analytical essays.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Short-answer questions test recall and identification: name a technique, identify a feature or state a production fact accurately and concisely.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Medium-answer questions typically require explanation of how a film language element creates meaning, connecting description to analysis in a few sentences.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Extended questions demand sustained argument with multiple examples, clear structure and a conclusion that directly answers the question set.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Reading the question carefully is essential: many students lose marks by answering a different question from the one actually asked.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: The mark scheme rewards precise film language terminology, specific examples and clear connections between technique and meaning.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Command Words & Question Types
cards.back: Timing is critical: allocate roughly one minute per mark and ensure extended answers receive sufficient time for planning and structuring.
